Category: Super Luxury
Fabrication: DV29 - 25,000eb - 5 Months
Enhances: Sandevistan
Option Slots: 0 (Cyberware Enhancement)

Iconic Sandevistan Operating System. The Sandevistan now wants one more Neuralware Option Slot, counts as an installation of Borgware for Maximum Humanity Loss, and costs a non-FBC user with no Cyberspine 1d6 Humanity every time they trigger it. In exchange it needs no Action to trigger, its initiative bonus climbs by 3 to +6, and it runs 9 seconds (3 Rounds). While it burns the user can dodge Ranged Attacks whatever their REF if they couldn't already, ignores every penalty to MOVE and to Evasion checks, and gets +2 on Aimed Shots. A Solo may also reassign their Combat Awareness Points without an Action whenever they take an Aimed Shot, use an Alternate Firing Mode, or resolve a Martial Arts Special Move. Once it drops, 60 seconds (20 Rounds) of cooldown, unless the user pays 3 Humanity per consecutive activation inside the minute (3, then 6, then 9).

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Super Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.
  • Change the Sandevistan's initiative effect to +6 while this OS is installed.
  • The extra Option Slot it consumes, and the Borgware it counts as, are applied by hand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Cyberware).
